ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Primary brand accent — filled CTAs, outlined action borders, icon fills, decorative accents, sparkline highlights. The only chromatic color in the interface; its vividness against the achromatic canvas makes every action feel switched on

peach-wash.$description: Peach Wash — Soft tinted surface — pill-badge backgrounds, subtle highlight panels, secondary button fills where a quieter orange is needed

snow-canvas.$description: Snow Canvas — Primary page background and elevated surface — the base on which all other elements sit

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text color for headings, body, and nav. Used for icon strokes and form input values

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Secondary and helper text — muted descriptions, captions, placeholder strings

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Tertiary text — timestamps, micro-labels, fine print beneath primary content

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, FAQ separators, input field borders, icon outline strokes

pebble-gray.$description: Pebble Gray — Subtle alternating section backgrounds and disabled state fills

geist.$description: Universal type family — all headings, body, nav, buttons, cards, footer. The tight line-height (1.0–1.11) on display sizes and 700 weight creates a dense, confident display voice; 400 at 1.4 keeps body readable without feeling loose.
